description: GalaxyModel parameters (P4-A). Units: kpc, degrees, emissivity in Lsun(V) pc^-3, dust opacity kappa_V in 1/kpc. Model frame: origin Sgr A*, z = physical mid-plane normal (tilted so the Sun sits z0 above it), x from the Sun's projection towards the centre, y towards l = 90 deg (direction of rotation at the Sun). Arm azimuth beta (Reid 2019): 0 towards the Sun as seen from the centre, increasing in the direction of Galactic rotation (clockwise seen from the north Galactic pole).

sun.source: R0: GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10; z0: Bennett & Bovy 2019, MNRAS 482, 1417 (same values as src/core/units.ts)

thinDisk.source: hR, hz: Bland-Hawthorn & Gerhard 2016, ARA&A 54, 529 (Table 6); j0 = 0.03 Lsun/pc^3 so that 2 j0 hz = 18 Lsun/pc^2, the local V-band disc surface brightness of Flynn et al. 2006 (MNRAS 372, 1149), approximate; inner depletion inside the bar (Freudenreich 1998, ApJ 492, 495, approximate)

thickDisk.source: Bland-Hawthorn & Gerhard 2016, ARA&A 54, 529: thick/thin local density ratio f = 0.12, hR 2.0 kpc, hz 0.9 kpc

bulge.source: Boxy/peanut bulge axis ratios 10:6.3:2.6 rounded (Wegg & Gerhard 2013, MNRAS 435, 1874); j0 tuned so bulge + bar give ~1e10 Lsun(V) (Bland-Hawthorn & Gerhard 2016), approximate

bar.source: Long bar half-length 5.0 kpc, angle 27 deg to the Sun-centre line, near end at positive l (Wegg, Gerhard & Portail 2015, MNRAS 450, 4050; Bland-Hawthorn & Gerhard 2016); widths and j0 approximate

armProfile.source: Arm width grows 0.042 kpc per kpc of radius (Reid et al. 2019, ApJ 885, 131); stellar/optical arms drawn 2x the maser-traced widths (approximate); young-population emissivity, scale length/height and old-disk arm contrast (arm/interarm ~2, Drimmel & Spergel 2001, ApJ 556, 181) are approximate

dust.source: hR 5.0 kpc, hz 0.1 kpc (Misiriotis et al. 2006, A&A 459, 113); kappa_V tuned to ~1.3 mag/kpc in the local mid-plane and A_V ~30 mag towards Sgr A*; dust on the inner (concave) arm edges (density-wave shocks, Roberts 1969); R:V:B extinction ratios from Cardelli, Clayton & Mathis 1989 (R_V = 3.1); approximate

hii.source: Procedural HII clumps along the arms (one hashed clump per 0.5 kpc cell, ~45% occupied); colour of Halpha + Hbeta + [NII] emission; approximate, artist-level

photometry.source: Sun V-band-equivalent luminous flux 3.828e26 W x 93 lm/W (luminous efficacy of sunlight); calibration multiplier for continuity with the stars panorama (1 = none)
